· Immediate start

ABC Heavy Engineering are seeking to employ suitably qualified Metal Machinist to join our busy team of professionals working out of our Paget depot and various field sites in Queensland.

To succeed in this position, you will need to have industry related experience within similar positions, a strong work ethic and strong safety focus.

The ability to carry out work with minimal supervision, a keen and enthusiastic approach to your work and willingness to work over time will help you ensure success in this role.
Set up and operate a variety of machine tools to produce precision parts and instruments. Includes precision instrument makers who fabricate, modify, or repair mechanical instruments.
Fabricate and modify parts to make or repair machine tools or maintain industrial machines.
Apply knowledge of mechanics, shop mathematics, metal properties, layout, and machining procedures.
Carry out maintenance and machining as directed on company and, client assets.
Area of operation is, but not limited to the Paget workshop and on-site works including client operated plant and equipment.
To ensure that all company and client assets operate at maximum efficiency with minimum down time.
To ensure safe and efficient work practices are adhered to at all times.
Perform routine and corrective maintenance, machining & project work in a heavy engineering or mining environment in a safe, legal and effective manner

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer, where all applicants are treated with fairness and respect and have equal access to all opportunities available. At ABC Heavy Engineering, diversity is about creating a respectful and inclusive workplace that recognises the unique contributions and perspectives of our employees, working together to deliver extraordinary results.

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super
